description: Replace one of your site's pages with new content: the privacy policy, terms and conditions, account deletion instructions (both stores ask for this page when an app has accounts) or support page with an FAQ. Write it in Markdown (default) or HTML; scripts, forms and event handlers are removed. Base it on what the app really does and collects (get_app_privacy shows its store privacy data), and include a contact email.

content.description: The whole page, up to 100000 characters. It replaces the current one.

site.description: Your site: its address ("habitly" for habitly.apppage.net) or id, as list_my_sites returns.

name: set_page
title: Write a site page
